strategies.name: Every session (control)
strategies.note: The same 9:00 CT entry on every session with bars. Every day-trade strategy is read against this row.

strategies.name: Wide day, wide opening range

strategies.name: Wide opening range, VIX 20 to 30
strategies.note: The opening range plus the regime that lifted it most in the analysis.

strategies.name: Wide opening range, 2 to 5% off the high

strategies.name: Any wide opening range
strategies.note: The opening range alone, as the control for A1 to A3.

strategies.name: Narrow day, narrow opening range
strategies.note: The no-trade corner, scored so the cost of trading it is on the record.

strategies.name: Every session, hold 3 (control)
strategies.note: Entered at every open and held three sessions. Every hold strategy is read against this row.

strategies.name: Wide day, hold 3 sessions
strategies.note: Enter the next open after a wide day, exit at the third close.

strategies.name: Wide day, hold 5 sessions
strategies.note: Same entry, held to the fifth close.

strategies.name: 2 to 5% off the high, VIX 15 to 20, wide day, hold 3

strategies.name: Narrow day, VIX under 15, within 2% of the high, hold 3
